set.body: Acceptance criteria: only samples allowed by the declared validity and gap policy drive velocity classification; off-screen outer samples cannot classify an interior sample as motion; a missing middle sample cannot be silently absorbed; event intervals and source ranges exclude or explicitly bridge gaps; short runs remain Unclassified rather than disappearing; fixation and saccade summaries use only their declared source support; sample labels and duration accounting satisfy the DetectionResult partition laws.
set.title: Repair I-VT invalid-sample handling and temporal accounting
